settings.notifications.heading: Notifications
settings.notifications.rail: Which of these you want to see while you are using Trevora.

settings.language.note: Service words like odometer, brake pad and change oil stay in English, because that is what shops and mechanics say. This changes the rest of the app.
records.title: Records
records.searchPlaceholder: Search service, part, shop, or notes
drafts.heading: Not finished yet
drafts.note: Saved, but not added to your history until you finish and confirm.
count.unfinished.one: {count} service record you started but have not finished
count.unfinished.other: {count} service records you started but have not finished
method.title: How do you want to add it?
method.sub: Step 2 of 6 · you will check everything before it saves, whichever you pick
method.skipNote: Entering from a vehicle page? This step is skipped.
method.receipt.title: Photo of the receipt
method.receipt.body: We read the details off it. Multi-page receipts are fine — keep them in printed order.
method.receipt.foot: Every field will show where its value came from.
method.voice.title: Voice note
method.voice.body: Say what was done. We write it down, and you can edit every word of it.
method.voice.foot: Quickest when you have no paper.
method.manual.title: Type it in
method.manual.body: Your own words. Nothing is read or guessed — what you type is what saves.
method.manual.foot: Best for an old record you already know.
receipt.title: The receipt
receipt.sub: Add every page of one visit. Photograph them, upload them, or both.
receipt.tip1: Flat surface, good lighting, no glare or shadows
receipt.tip2: All four corners of the page visible in frame
receipt.tip3: Sharp focus — hold steady before taking the photo
receipt.order: The order here is the order we read them in.
receipt.longer: A long receipt takes longer. Nothing is lost while this runs.
receipt.needOne: Add at least one receipt page.
receipt.uploadFail: The pages could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
receipt.readFail: The receipt could not be read. Try again.
voice.title: Say what was done
voice.original: The original stays exactly as you said it. This is what we will read.
voice.copyKept: This is the copy we keep. Editing here changes what we read.
voice.noRecorder: This browser cannot record audio. You can type what you want to say instead.
voice.noMic: Trevora could not reach the microphone. Allow access, or type what you want to say instead.
voice.needNote: Record a voice note, or type what you want to say, before going on.
manual.title: Type in the details
manual.sub: Only the date and the total are required.
manual.serviceThenLines: A service, then the lines that paid for it.
vehicle.noRecordsHere: No records for this vehicle yet
auth.wholeOfIt: Name, email, a password — that is the whole of it.
auth.needEmail: Enter an email address we can reach you at.
auth.retype: Re-type it so we know it is what you meant.
auth.mismatch: These two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a number.
auth.acceptTerms: Please accept the Terms to continue.
review.title: Check the details
review.coveredBy: Insurance or warranty covered part of this
review.coveredHelp: How much of the total someone else paid. Leave blank if you paid all of it.
review.totalFirst: Enter the total cost first, then how much of it was covered.
review.nothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded with this one.
confirm.title: This is what will be saved
confirm.notEditable: Nothing here is editable. Go back if anything is wrong.
confirm.checked: I have checked these details and they match my receipt
confirm.required: Required. You can edit the record later, and the change is logged.
confirm.stillNeed: Some fields still need attention. Go back to checking to finish them.
confirm.noLines: No itemised lines — a total and nothing about what it paid for.
saved.title: Saved to your records
lines.noItemised: No itemised lines for this service.
lines.inOrder: Lines stay in the order they print, so you can read down the paper.
lines.matches: The lines add up to the receipt total. Nothing is missing.
lines.fillTotal: Fill in the total cost and this will check it against the lines.
lines.noneHaveAmount: None of the lines have an amount, so they cannot be checked against the total.
share.noOne: No one has access right now
share.nothingElse: No other vehicle, no drafts, no edits
requests.title: Shared access
requests.nothingShared: Nothing is shared until you approve it
notif.title: Notifications
notif.requestsArrive: Mechanic access requests for your vehicles arrive here.
addVehicle.title: Add a vehicle
addVehicle.nicknameHelp: Optional. It is how most people recognise their own car in a list.
set.title: Account settings
set.sub: Your notifications, your details, and your password.
set.detailsHelp: Your name and email are how Trevora identifies you on every record.
set.passwordHelp: We ask for your current password first, to make sure it is you.
set.noMatch: These two do not match yet.
set.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
set.badEmail: That does not look like an email address.
set.whoCanSee: These are about who can see your records.
set.youDecide: You decide before anyone can see anything.
set.noLongerSee: The mechanic can no longer see the vehicle.
set.savedEmail: Saved. Check your inbox to confirm the new email address.
set.thisDevice: On this device. Your records stay where they are.
set.deleteWarn1: A mechanic reading this history right now will lose it.
set.deleteWarn2: Any share link or mechanic access you have granted stops working immediately.
set.deleteWarn3: This removes every vehicle and service record on this account, along with their receipt images.
shell.signOutBody: Your records stay where they are. You will need to sign in again to reach them.
shell.unsavedWarn: Anything you are part-way through adding is not saved yet and will be lost.
parts.pickPart: Pick a part to see its full service history.
vehicle.trySearch: Try a shop name, a part, or the kind of service.
vehicle.deleteBody: It disappears from this vehicle's history and from everything worked out from it.
vehicle.onlyVehicleGoes: Nothing has been filed against it yet, so only the vehicle goes.
rail.fixAbove: Fix what is listed above to continue.
rail.nothingStopping: Nothing is stopping this from being saved. Anything still flagged is yours to judge.
rail.oneThing: One thing has to change before this can be saved. The rest is yours to judge.
rail.savedAsYouGo: Your changes are saved as you continue.
garage.latestAcrossAll: Latest service records across all vehicles
garage.chartHint: Add a record and twelve months of service activity chart here.
garage.startReceipt: We read the date, shop, services and cost off it. You correct anything before it saves.
garage.startVoice: Say what was done and we write it down. Quickest when you have no paper.
garage.startManual: Your own words, nothing guessed. Best for a service you already know.
ai.loading: Putting this record into plain language…
ai.fromRecord: Written from the record itself rather than by the explanation service.
ai.disclaimer: This explanation is for understanding only and does not replace professional mechanic judgment.
